title: Beyond Direct Access: Resource Hijacking in LLM Agents
abstract: arXiv:2608.15108v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Large language model agents are increasingly connected to high-value resources such as computing infrastructure, credentials, usage budgets, identities, private knowledge, communication channels, and organizational workflows. Existing agent security research mainly studies attacks on instructions, data, and tool behaviors, while high-value resources accessible to agents have received much less attention as direct attack targets. We are the first to identify and systematically study agent resource hijacking, a security blind spot in which attackers induce agents to invoke, consume, transfer, or control high-value resources for their own goals without directly obtaining those resources or their credentials. To study this threat, we introduce ResourceHijackBench together with an automated pipeline for generating resource hijacking cases. We organize high-value agent resources into six categories and construct 300 attack scenarios with 900

translated_title: 超越直接访问：LLM代理中的资源劫持
translated_abstract: arXiv:2608.15108v1 公告类型：交叉 摘要：大型语言模型代理日益连接到高价值资源，如计算基础设施、凭据、使用预算、身份、私有知识、通信渠道和组织工作流。现有的代理安全研究主要关注对指令、数据和工具行为的攻击，而代理可访问的高价值资源作为直接攻击目标却受到的关注较少。我们首次识别并系统研究了代理资源劫持，这是一种安全盲点，攻击者诱导代理调用、消耗、转移或控制高价值资源以实现其自身目标，而无需直接获取这些资源或其凭据。为研究这一威胁，我们引入了ResourceHijackBench以及一个用于生成资源劫持案例的自动化流水线。我们将高价值代理资源组织为六个类别，并构建了300个攻击场景和900个变体。
tldr: 本文首次系统识别并研究了LLM代理中的资源劫持攻击，提出ResourceHijackBench基准和自动化生成流水线，涵盖六类高价值资源及300个攻击场景。
en_tdlr: This paper is the first to systematically identify and study resource hijacking attacks in LLM agents, proposing ResourceHijackBench with an automated pipeline covering six resource categories and 300 attack scenarios.
